title: Tune Muon matrix LR (MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.05)
description: Raised MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 (25% increase), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: Regressed val_bpb to 1.006023 vs baseline 1.002279 (+0.37%). Suggests the current MATRIX_LR=0.04 is close to or past a local optimum for this width/depth/batch config -- raising it further destabilizes training somewhat rather than helping. A follow-up (if anyone wants to spend a run) would be to try lowering it (e.g. 0.03) rather than raising further, but given the regression direction and magnitude, I would not prioritize this lever again without a stronger prior.
